notes.observation: Unit 1 repeats title; extraction begins with split `தி ருச்சியில்`.
notes.translation_action: Use title metadata and read securely as Tiruchirappalli.

notes.observation: Three joins: `அப்படிப் / பட்டவர்களுடைய`; unit 2→3 after `இந்தச் சூழ்நிலையை`; unit 3→4 after `திராவிட / முன்னேற்றக் கழகம்`.
After telegram confirms marriage, Anna warns cadres against haste, anger and personal hostility.
notes.translation_action: Preserve long cautionary reasoning rather than summarize as tactical delay.

notes.observation: Anna publishes names of those withdrawing from DK work under heading `கண்ணீர்த் துளிகள்`; Periyar then uses the phrase mockingly.
notes.translation_action: Retain same English form in both uses to preserve rhetorical reversal.

notes.observation: At Pavazhakkara Street Anna argues against seizing DK/label, warns reactionaries could exploit conflict, and proposes Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam.
notes.translation_action: Preserve label/policy/program distinction and collective-action logic.

notes.observation: 17 Sept 1949 organizational meeting and Robinson Park public launch are linked; rain, committees and Anna's writing/speech freedom call are central.
notes.translation_action: Preserve date, setting and quoted call.

notes.observation: 2 May 1950 Madhava Menon order makes Hindi compulsory forms 1–6; source says DMK resistance leads to optional status after two months.
Dravida Nadu is ordered to furnish ₹3000 `ஜாமீன்`; judges Rajamannar and Chandra Reddy quash order and refund; Anna returns donations.
notes.translation_action: Use security/security deposit, not criminal bail.
